html_source: 11 February 1885 cover of Puck magazine, captioned "How Do They Like It Themselves?," showing Jeremiah O'Donovan Rossa and Johann Most shocked by violent attacks on themselves. At Most's feet his newspaper Freiheit proclaims, "Dynamite Everybody Herr Most." Source: picryl.com.
